description: Synthetic adult campaign. Onboarding, confinement/triage prerequisites and the actual spatial reducers prepare the completed space-recovery receipt. Those prerequisites are NOT browser-played. No B04 acceptance, movement, medical control or report is seeded.

Synthetic interruption fixture. The real escort reducer and native path solver prepare a group already across the door in soins, still escorting; the player resumes separately in hangar. Those preparatory moves are NOT browser-played.

Portable boundary fixture only: the same waiting group remains in soins while the player is in the docked personal ship. Native export/import must preserve the group; this initial version of the browser recipe does not claim a complete outside-ship route.
